layman_headline: Current positions are working — no reason to force a new trade in a cooling market.
layman_explanation: We hold Solana (up 1.7%) and Uniswap (up 5.5%), both moving toward their profit targets. The broader market is pulling back slightly with fear/greed dropping from 69 to 62, and Bitcoin dominance at 59.2% means money is flowing to Bitcoin rather than altcoins. The swing trade candidates available right now are either wildly overextended (PONS up 444%), stablecoins, or lack the technical data needed to make a confident entry.
layman_action: Hold your current positions and let them work toward their targets. UNI is approaching its exit target of $5.65 — consider taking profits if it gets there. No new buys today.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate pool is exceptionally weak this cycle. PONS is up 444% in 7 days and only 6.5% from ATH — textbook blow-off top risk. PUMP is down 51% from ATH with no technical indicators available and high BTC dominance headwinds. MON lacks any RSI/MACD data and is in a downtrend. Gold-backed tokens (XAUT, PAXG) are both down 5% weekly, likely reacting to US-Iran tensions easing. The remaining candidates are stablecoins. With Fear & Greed trending from 69 to 62 (worsening) and BTC dominance at 59.2%, this is not an environment to aggressively add altcoin exposure. Both existing positions (SOL +1.7%, UNI +5.5%) have clear stop-losses and are progressing toward targets. Capital preservation is the priority.
